A website designer in the Ardennes

My name is Alex and I build websites from Signy-l’Abbaye (08460). I work remotely for clients all over France, and the Ardennes is my home.

I make one-page websites, showcase websites and online shops. The offer is the same here as anywhere else: a clear price, a website checked by hand, then a subscription that takes care of the upkeep.

Freelancers, tradespeople, shopkeepers, holiday cottages, associations: if you are in Charleville-Mézières, Sedan, Rethel, Signy-l’Abbaye or a nearby village, we can meet to talk about your project. It is never required. A lot can be sorted out very well by phone or email.

Meet in person, or do it all remotely

Some people like to put a face to a name before getting started. Others do not have time to travel. Both suit me fine.

  • In person, in the Ardennes: we look together at what you do, your photos and your ideas.
  • Remotely: you write to me or we call, then you follow everything from your client area.

Either way, the price does not change and it is shown upfront. The website starts at €500, then the subscription costs €10 a month, with no commitment.

Being found near you

For a local business, it is not about competing with the whole of France. It all comes down to what local people search for: “roofer Rethel”, “florist Sedan”, “holiday cottage near Charleville”. Three things matter most.

  1. Your Google Business Profile, fully filled in, with the right category and your opening hours. It is what puts you on the map. The Google Business Profile guide explains how.
  2. The name of your town and the villages around it, written clearly on your pages. If you are in Rethel and you work as far as Signy-l’Abbaye, write both. Google does not guess your area.
  3. Real reviews left by your local customers. They reassure people who are unsure, and Google takes them into account.

Think too about the words people really use. Many say “Charleville” rather than “Charleville-Mézières”. For a holiday cottage, the Meuse valley or the Ardennes forest often mean more than a simple town name. Slip these words naturally into your text, without repeating them on every line.

No mass-produced pages for each village. One genuine, useful page is worth more than twenty copies where only the village name changes. Google spots it, and so do your customers.

To go further, read the guide how to be visible on Google.

An example from the Ardennes: Flore et Chenilles

Flore et Chenilles makes everlasting flowers from chenille wire, handmade in Signy-l’Abbaye. I built its website, an online shop to show and sell its creations. The shop opens very soon.

It is a good example of what a website can bring to a local business: getting known by people in the Ardennes looking for a gift idea, and selling further afield too. The other websites are on the Our work page.

How it works

  1. You contact me through the form, saying whether you would like to meet.
  2. We talk it through, at a meeting in the Ardennes or on the phone.
  3. I build your website: a one-page website in 3 to 5 days, a showcase website in 1 to 2 weeks, a shop in 2 to 3 weeks.
  4. I put it online after checking it, then I take care of its upkeep and your changes.

As for payment, you pay 25% when you order, and the rest when the website is online.

Your questions

Do I need to be in the Ardennes to work with you?

No. I build websites for clients all over France, remotely. Being in the Ardennes just makes it easier to meet, if you would like to.

Do you travel to meet clients?

Yes, within the Ardennes, for example in Charleville-Mézières, Sedan, Rethel or Signy-l’Abbaye. Tell me in your message where you are, and we will find a time.

Is the price different for a business in the Ardennes?

No. Whether we meet or not, the price is the same for everyone: from €500 for the build, then the monthly subscription.

Do you make a page for each town?

No, not in bulk. I prefer one genuine page that names your town and the places where you work, rather than copies that help nobody.
